description: Trusted maximum write roots and required cross-issue boundaries for planning. Committed policy, not model output: a generated plan may narrow these, never widen them.

18.note: Collin CAD Access decoder foundation. Shared bounded release parsing and vendor-neutral source records are owned by issue 43.

119.note: Application port boundary, bootstrap 2.3. The application package is the subject. Three narrower adapter roots are deliberate rather than a blanket libs/property-tax-adapters/: the S3 manifest serializer must move with the manifest value it serializes, since shipping one without the other leaves a value the writer cannot write; the six Texas county definitions are populated with the expected media types the accepted registry requirement names, which a shared default cannot express; and the objectstore tests cover both. No county layout, parser, or acquisition behaviour is in scope, and no migration is.
